_about: Display names of the six headline CARLA experiments (user, 2026-11-26): QwenPolicy + the components that tell them apart. Old IDs stay the run labels, the folders on E: and the log entries; use display names in the thesis, figures and reports. Shared by all six: Qwen-style transformer trunk, frozen CARLA-pretrained regnety_032 encoder (FE), waypoint predictor (WP), one front camera. Components were read from each run's run_config.json and record on 2026-11-26. Short names (figures, narrow tables) use the short_tags; expanding them gives the display name.

tags.FE: frozen CARLA-pretrained image encoder (regnety_032 from the TF++ release)
tags.WP: waypoint predictor head, followed by the controller
tags.Overlay: planned route drawn into the camera image (route_overlay 1)
tags.NoOverlay: no route drawn into the image (route_overlay 0)
tags.Cov: base data plus the coverage data (dataset_all)
tags.FreshAdamW: optimizer restarted when fine-tuning from E15 epoch 15 (reset_optimizer 1, or new tensors forcing a restart)
tags.DetTok: 20 detector tokens (frozen DETR-style detector on the frozen encoder's map, <= 30 m, p >= 0.5)

experiments.checkpoint: arm E, epoch 15 (locate on E:; see docs/todo/TODO_ACTIVE.md A88)

experiments.recipe: E15 epoch 15 -> 30, route_overlay 0, optimizer kept, base data
r0ftf's recipe + object_tokens 20 (optimizer restarted by the new tensors)
